req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return all players sorted by their insertion order (id) when a GET request is made to /players/. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct sorting, a negative test to handle client errors, and a boundary test to ensure correct behavior at the limits of the dataset.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_sorted_by_id

tests.name: test_get_players_invalid_method
preconditions: The API is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ instead of GET.
expected: The response status code is 405 Method Not Allowed.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.post('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_get_all_players_boundary_case
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert len(players) == 26
